subject: Re: Post-call recap — ACME integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, embeddings)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — ACME integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, embeddings)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the items we agreed to follow up on. Please correct anything I mis-stated.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- High-level pain: inconsistent latency for user-facing chat, high token costs on search/rerank workflows, and strict security/compliance requirements for PII handling.
- Goals: 1) fix sub-200ms median response for short assistant responses, 2) reduce per-query embedding/rerank costs by ~30% via batching & quantization, 3) maintain auditability for queries and KV cache evictions.

Product fit & integration notes we discussed
- SDK changes: you will use Redwood SDK; plan to adopt our streaming client to reduce perceived latency (partial token streaming + structured JSON chunking).
- Function calling: you need deterministic, structured outputs for downstream processors — we recommended using our function-calling schema with strict type enforcement and post-call validation hooks.
- Streaming & structured outputs: for short assistant responses (system prompts under 256 tokens) we propose prefix caching + partial streaming. We flagged that structured outputs will be emitted as newline-delimited JSON chunks for easy ingestion.
- Embeddings & reranking: propose hybrid approach — dense embeddings for semantic recall + lightweight token-level reranking via a smaller reranker model hosted on Dedicated capacity. Batching and prefix caching to reduce cost.

Next steps (agreed)
1) ACME to share integration requirements + security questionnaire (you mentioned a slightly modified SOC2 pack) — Samir to send attachments by EOD tomorrow.
2) Redwood to provide an engineering runbook for the streaming SDK and a short demo repo (example: streaming + function-calling + structured outputs). Vivek will take lead and share by Thurs 8/20.
3) Quick alignment call: 30 min POC scoping with your infra/security on Mon 8/24.
4) Redwood to propose an initial pricing estimate for a Dedicated reranker and expected per-query unit cost improvement.

Attachments referenced: sample integration checklist (we'll send), SOC2 summary (we'll attach for review).

If that all looks right I'll mark these as action items and get Vivek's demo repo over to you.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — ACME integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, embeddings)

Thanks Marissa — this is a great write-up and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- For the reranker, our traffic profile is bursty: baseline ~300 qps with spikes to 1.2k qps during business hours. Latency SLO for synchronous search is 120ms P95.
- We will likely run the reranker in a separate VPC with strict egress controls. Can Redwood support VPC peering and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?
- For structured outputs, we need deterministic JSON schemas and a validation step performed inside our pipeline (we prefer the SDK to fail-fast on schema mismatch).

I've attached our integration checklist and the security questionnaire (answers in progress). Priya from our infra/security is CC'd and will join the scoping call on 8/24.

Samir
Head of Search & AI | ACME Inc.
samir@acme.io | +1 (650) 555-0119

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — ACME integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, embeddings)

Hi Samir — Vivek from the engineering team here. A few technical clarifications so we can scope the demo/repo correctly: 

1) Streaming: Do you expect token-level streaming for the UI (partial tokens) or coarse-grained chunked updates (paragraph-level)? Token-level requires websocket/HTTP2 streaming; chunked updates can be done over HTTP chunked responses.
2) Rate shaping: Do you have an existing rate-limiter or do you want Redwood to enforce per-customer burst limits? For the reranker we'll include a suggested batching policy (batch size vs latency trade-off).
3) Function calling schema: can you paste one example of the JSON schema your pipeline expects? We plan to include an option to validate server-side and return a 4xx-like structured error for enforcement.

I'll put together a small example repo demonstrating: streaming client (Node + Python), function-calling enforcement, and an embeddings+rerank pipeline that shows cost improvement with batching. Planning to share by Thu 8/20.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — ACME integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, embeddings)

Samir —

Perfect, thanks for the details. We can support KMS/HSM and VPC peering — I'll include that in the tech runbook. For the P95 120ms SLO we discussed a few options: Dedicated reranker colocated in your region + prefix caching for the assistant flows (short responses) + streaming to mask tail latency. We'll include estimated unit-cost improvements in the pricing doc.

Action items assigned:
- ACME: finish security questionnaire and send final answers (Priya/Security).
- Redwood (Vivek): share demo repo by 8/20 with Node + Python examples + server-side schema enforcement.
- Redwood (Dev): draft a Dedicated reranker pricing estimate and initial commit size (Dev, please see note below).
- Scheduling: 30-min scoping call 8/24. I'll send a calendar invite once Priya confirms availability.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.

Best,
Marissa

- I'll add a callout for KMS/HSM and VPC peering as optional add-ons (enterprise plan).
